english.title: Young person employ a child on bingo or club premises - Gambling Act 2005
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a young person aged **(..SPECIFY AGE..), employed a child aged **(..SPECIFY AGE..) to perform a function on premises where, and at a time when

(A)_[facilities were provided for the playing of bingo]_
(B)_[facilities for gambling were provided in accordance with a club gaming permit or a club machine permit]_
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 53 and 62(2)(b) of the Gambling Act 2005.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) This offence wording applies to young persons, aged 16 or 17, only; for adults see the offence wording GA05023/H8202.
(ii) Section 45 of the Gambling Act 2005 provides that "child" means an individual who is less than 16 years old.
(iii) Section 63 of the Gambling Act 2005 provides the defence of reasonable belief about a person's age.
